caption: The video captures several glossy brown pretzels arranged on a mirror-like gray surface against a dark blue-teal backdrop. On the left, a pretzel tumbles and rotates in place near the surface, its form shifting from an edge-on diagonal bar to a front-facing knot while its reflection mirrors the motion. A short horizontal pretzel rod lies at rest in the center, casting a steady reflection directly beneath it. To the right, a single airborne pretzel spins about a horizontal axis and climbs steadily upward, the gap between it and its reflection widening as it rises. A static pile of pretzels occupies the far-right edge, unchanged throughout. A tiny bright speck drifts faintly near the frame's center. The horizon line and framing remain fixed, holding the scene in a slow, suspended motion.
